name: Blasphemy
overview: Scripture solemnly warns against blasphemy, particularly the misuse or profaning of God's name, as seen in commands not to take the Lord's name in vain or swear falsely by it (Exodus 20:7; Leviticus 19:12). The holiness of God's name is emphasized, with a call for it to be hallowed among His people (Leviticus 22:32). The narrative of the son of Shelomith, who blasphemed and cursed the Lord, illustrates the serious consequences of such sin within the community (Leviticus 24:10-12). These passages collectively affirm that blasphemy is a grave offense against God's holiness and demands reverent honor toward His name.
